description.value: Syringa Park sits on the Arrow Lake Reservoir in the Kootenays, offering swimming, fishing, and boating from a large frontcountry campground, with Rocky Mountain bighorn sheep grazing nearby bluffs and Douglas fir and grassland ecosystems worth exploring.

address.value: Hwy 3A, 19 km northwest of Castlegar, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Syringa Park is a BC Parks provincial campground on Lower Arrow Lake, 19 km northwest of Castlegar on Hwy 3A. OSM tags show capacity of 61 sites, fee=yes, internet_access=no, and sanitary_dump_station=yes. The website confirms reservations are available via camping.bcparks.ca for frontcountry and group camping. Most amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) are not mentioned on the website, so they remain null. The OSM phone numbers appear to be the park operator's direct lines, which cannot be confirmed from the fetched website content.
concerns: OSM phone numbers (+1-250-352-0015 and +1-250-825-4212) appear to be park operator numbers and could not be verified from the website content
OSM email (anne@kootenayswparks.com) is for the park operator, not BC Parks general contact; may change with operator contracts
No street address available in OSM or on the website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate BC Parks campground with 61 sites on a major Kootenay highway route, well-suited for touring cyclists travelling between Castlegar and Nelson.
